# the CLICS3 colexification network as published (graphs/network-3-families.gml): undirected edges between Concepticon concepts colexified (same word form) in languages of the 30 CLICS3 lexibank datasets.
# kept: edges with FamilyWeight >= 3 (attested in >= 3 Glottolog families): 4228 edges over 2919 concepts. Concept A is the alphabetically first gloss.
# columns: families = FamilyWeight, languages = LanguageWeight, words = WordWeight (number of colexifying word pairs).
